Banjara: To divali habbana kyon aacharan kare chi?

English: Tomorrow we offer Puja to our ancestors
We do Lakshmi Puja and in the evening we burst crackers
Banjara: Ham Lakshmi puja karacha an san jasi ham pataki mara

English: In Lambadi tradition, married girls do “Mera” ritual
Banjara: Mera Banjara ma kawar choriya mera karacha

English: Unmarried girls hold diyas in hand and do prayers for everyone’s well-being
Banjara: Kawar choriya deepa hate ma jalle se jini acho vedken puja karacha

English: Okay, now I have to go home. Do come home
Banjara: Sari ama ghar janu, ghare aa
